headline: Hand-poured in Vermont with 100% natural soy wax
body: No synthetic fragrances and zero plastic packaging. Poured in small batches in Vermont using ethically sourced soy, ensuring a clean burn for your home.
rationale: This copy directly addresses the Sustainability Buyer's demand for specific sustainability claims and supply chain transparency by explicitly stating the origin, exact wax type, and absence of plastic and synthetics, while completely steering clear of vague eco claims.
